summary.text: Robert Washburn is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 30, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Washburn was the Republican nominee for Merrimack 30 in 2024, when Gary Woods defeated him in the November 5 general election.
In 2025 he ran for the Concord City Council at-large, where incumbents Amanda Grady Sexton and Fred Keach defeated him, Fisto Ndayishimiye and Jeanne Chase in the November 4 general election.
